scope: Producer ticket 04 on the format-aligned branch; no engine source changes in this ticket.

resolved: Scoped client descriptor ownership on fatal assertion failures.
Prove both current server send queues are saturated before and after SQL using kernel diagnostics.

earlier_attempts.reason: Broad [socket] filter included hidden credential case without UID isolation; corrected filter and separate isolated run.
String-compressed SQL fixture did not saturate output; explicit uncompressed disposable fixture established large capture.
Socket-diagnostic output column parsing did not identify two sockets; corrected from actual ss output.
Local installer refused replacement while this task real-server harness was running; retried after harness cleanup.
Long default PL socket path caused Java startup failure; terminated this task CTest and child, reran with short CUBRID_TMP.
Concurrent mode suites share the OOS unittestdb fixture; serialized reruns avoid DB contention.

limitations: Native no-wait argument is source audit of trylock/unlock plus sampling/cancellation tests and real SQL/shutdown; no controlled native held-mutex experiment claimed.
Queue test accounts pending wire bytes separately from kernel send memory; it is not allocator/RSS/performance evidence.
External shell repository, develop port, consumer integration, controlled dirty/eviction and dedicated-host release performance remain their owning later gates.
Binaries were built before the final commit amendment; final source content matches the tested/reviewed tree. Binary hashes are recorded independently.

requirements.requirement: Two admitted clients and excess demand
requirements.evidence: `Admission overload leaves both admitted clients usable` checks 128 refusals and subsequent scans on both clients; installed-server isolation records refusals during committed SQL
`The scan floor applies across both clients and preserves increasing sequences`: 99,999 / 100,000 / 100,001 microseconds; installed server also uses sequential accepted scans

requirements.requirement: Fragmentation, coalescing, malformed requests and EOF
requirements.evidence: `Fragmented controls...`, `Malformed scan controls...`, `Controls cannot exceed...`, negotiation and premature-request cases; coalesced requests violate the sequential request contract and close without starting a scan
Socket hello and scan boundary cases plus `Frame and depth limits hold below at and above their boundaries`; complete identity or explicit refusal is exercised over real I/O

requirements.requirement: 65,536 records/slots, 64 MiB scan and 100 ms traversal
requirements.evidence: Deterministic scan and wire boundary cases at limit minus one, limit, limit plus one; lower scan-byte budgets isolate footer reservation since ordinary scalar frames do not reach 64 MiB before the record cap

requirements.requirement: 64 KiB output and footer under backpressure
requirements.evidence: `Backpressure bounds queued bytes and reserves a truthful footer` establishes sampling saturation, accounts generated wire bytes minus bytes in the kernel, then drains a validated partial footer without additional samples
Real stalled handshake/scan tests plus `Write stall deadline...` at 249,999 / 250,000 / 250,001 microseconds; incomplete bytes never publish a capture
Real idle greeting expiration and delayed metadata tests, plus `Handshake deadline...` at 499,999 / 500,000 / 500,001 microseconds; incoming fragments cannot reset the deadline

Deterministic before-write checks at 1,999,999 / 2,000,000 / 2,000,001 microseconds; `Real slow draining...` establishes saturation before 100 ms and observes at least ten real write-progress events with gaps below 250 ms, then closure at 2 s without publication
Sampling stops after disconnect/shutdown; repeated lifecycle tests check peer EOF, bounded stop and unchanged descriptor count; real shutdown closes both stalled exchanges and removes its own socket
Explicit credential suite requires two mapped UIDs; the different-UID child retains the server group; root connecting to a non-root endpoint is refused before data exchange
Unsafe directory modes, symlinks, regular files, wrong-owner sockets/directories, active sockets, confirmed stale sockets and backlog-full `EAGAIN` probes; checked identities remain preserved

Endpoint and installed-server pathname replacement; SQL remains usable after failed activation and after removing the conflict without rebinding; restart changes incarnation, retains persistent identity and refuses an old expectation
Canonical wire corpus rejects malformed/count/sequence/incarnation/EOF captures; actual scan framing is validated before publication; stable refusals carry no paths or OS error text
